meta.name: Power Book II Ghost
meta.description:
Picking up just days after the “Power” finale, this sequel series follows Tariq navigating his new life, in which his desire to shed his father’s legacy comes up against the mounting pressure to save his family.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 6 Sept 2020 · United States of America · Language: English · 60 min
Studio: G-Unit Film & Television, Atmosphere Television, CBS Studios · Network: STARZ

Not complete. On your server: S1 7/10 (missing E8-10) | S2 9/10 (missing E3) | S3 6/10 (missing E7-10) | S4 not on server

On your server — Audio: English (from file names)

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: As Tariq St. Patrick begins his new life at Stansfield University, he's torn between two worlds.

videos.title: Exceeding Expectations
videos.overview: Tariq St. Patrick adjusts to the changes that were prompted by a dramatic change in how his world is operated, which includes the death of his father and his mother confronting murder charges for a crime that her son was responsible for.

videos.title: Play The Game
videos.overview: Tariq struggles with the weight of providing for his mother's mounting legal defence while juggling the rigours of Ivy League life.

videos.title: The Prince
videos.overview: After Monet's agreed to do business with him, Tariq initiates his play to control the drug market on campus, while insulating his and Monet's involvement.

videos.title: The Gift of the Magi
videos.overview: It's Tariq's 18th birthday, but there's no cause for celebration, or time. Saxe brings him news that could blow up Tasha's case. Tariq is concerned that Brayden's budding relationship could put their business in danger.

videos.title: Good vs. Evil
videos.overview: Tariq's hands are tied, fearing that fully letting Brayden in on their arrangement with the Tejadas has put him on a violent collision course with Cane, who demonstrates the price paid for using his name.

videos.title: Sex Week
videos.overview: As the heat is turned up on campus, Tariq isn't trying to be left in the cold with Lauren. Or is it Diana he's in to?

videos.title: Free Will Is Never Free
videos.overview: Tariq tries to resume his normal college life. Brayden provides Tariq an escape. Monet makes plans for the business to protect her children. Cane seeks out a new family to take the streets for himself.

videos.title: Selfless Acts?
videos.overview: Tariq will need to let go of the past to save whats left of his family. Diana helps Monet repair the business, but sees Monet is distracted. Cane takes a lesson from a new ally to get what he wants.

videos.title: Gettin' These Ends
videos.overview: Davis questions Tariq's client referrals; Cane finds Brayden eager to prove himself and gives him the chance to make some real money; Zeke needs everyone's help to assure his professional basketball future is protected.

videos.title: Coming Home to Roost
videos.overview: Tariq races against the clock for Yasmine. With pressure being placed on Monet from her family and from Mecca, she struggles to wear the Tejada crown, and questions whether she has to anymore.

videos.title: What's Free?
videos.overview: Tariq reflects on where he is in his life and who he can trust. Brayden must decide whether to protect his family or help save Tariq's. Monet's faced with a new world order within her own family.

videos.title: Forced My Hand
videos.overview: Tariq, finds himself on a quest for normalcy, which is not in arm's reach as he returns to school and attempts to find evidence of his innocence. Helping Tariq, as always, are Davis and Saxe.

videos.title: Drug Related
videos.overview: Davis advises Tariq on the best way to protect himself against Jenny and Saxe questions what lines Davis crossed in doing so. Carrie realizes her own actions have put her students in harm's way.

videos.title: A Fair Fight?
videos.overview: Tariq's fate lies in the hands of Tate. Monet's choices feel out of her control. She must rely on Mecca to help salvage the pieces of her family. Mecca plays his hand to put Monet right where he wants her.

videos.title: Love and War
videos.overview: Tariq refuses to give up on his loved ones. Tariq must help Monet save her own family. Monet, finally seeing the whole board, must move quickly to protect her family from Mecca.

videos.title: Your Perception, Your Reality
videos.overview: A new semester at Stansfield means a fresh start for Tariq. Brayden is learning the ropes at Weston Holdings, under his uncle Lucas. Monet grieves the loss of Zeke, while Cane searches for a new connect.

videos.title: Need vs. Greed
videos.overview: Tariq, Brayden, Effie, and Cane divvy up Noma’s product to push. Lorenzo sets a plan in motion to keep Monet off his trail after she orders him to find Zeke’s killer. Cane looks into what happened at Mecca’s hangar.

videos.title: Human Capital
videos.overview: Tariq and the rest of the team must find a way to get the product flowing at an even bigger scale. Tensions rise amongst the Tejadas when Lorenzo backs Cane’s plan. Saxe digs into the Theo Rollins case.

videos.title: The Land of Opportunity
videos.overview: The Tejadas and Davis discuss how they’re going to handle Whitman. Dru sets up a risky deal with the help of a family friend. The R.I.C.O. team gets a lead, Diana is encouraged to break ties with her family.

videos.title: No More Second Chances
videos.overview: A business deal takes Tariq, Brayden, and Effie to Milan. Monet digs deeper after Davis provides her new information regarding Zeke’s murder. Saxe doubles down to find out what Jenny is hiding.

videos.title: Land of Lies
videos.overview: Tariq demands answers after a startling revelation shakes up the relationships in his life — both business and personal. Tragedy brings the Tejadas to the brink of war as they work with the Castillos to enact revenge.

meta.slogan: Does the end justify the means?
